units.text: 2) terms covering construction or reconstruction of a capital construction facility shall be governed by this Federal Law's provisions on contracts for construction, reconstruction and major repairs of capital construction facilities.
units.label: Point 2 Part 60 Art. 112

units.text: 61. A contract under paragraph 56 of this Article shall separately state:
units.label: Part 61 Art. 112

units.text: 1) the cost of design documentation and/or engineering surveys;
units.label: Point 1 Part 61 Art. 112

units.text: 2) the cost of construction, reconstruction and/or major repairs of the capital construction facility;
units.label: Point 2 Part 61 Art. 112

units.text: 3) the cost of supplying equipment specified in the facility's design documentation and necessary for its operation, if the contract provides for that supply.
units.label: Point 3 Part 61 Art. 112

units.text: 61.1. A contract under paragraph 56 of this Article may provide:
units.label: Part 61.1 Art. 112

units.text: 1) a zero advance for stages involving design documentation and/or engineering surveys;
units.label: Point 1 Part 61.1 Art. 112

units.text: 2) a smaller advance for stages involving design documentation and/or engineering surveys and supply of equipment specified in the design documentation and necessary for operation, if the contract provides for its supply, than for stages involving construction, reconstruction and/or major repairs of the facility.
units.label: Point 2 Part 61.1 Art. 112

units.text: 62. Material terms of a contract under paragraph 56 of this Article may be amended during performance:
units.label: Part 62 Art. 112

units.text: 1) by agreement of the parties:
units.label: Point 1 Part 62 Art. 112

units.text: а) if the estimated construction, reconstruction or major repair cost, determined following verification of its reliability during State expert examination of design documentation, exceeds the contract price. Such amendment shall take account of that estimated cost and be based on a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation, the constituent entity's highest executive authority or the local administration for federal, constituent-entity or municipal procurement respectively, and may not increase the contract price by more than thirty percent;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 62 Art. 112

units.text: б) during construction, reconstruction and/or major repairs, to amend the contract price in the cases under Article 95(1), points 1.3 and 8, of this Federal Law, as regards the contractual cost of those works. A price amendment under Article 95(1)(8) of this Federal Law is subject to compliance with that point's requirements;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 62 Art. 112

units.text: в) during construction, reconstruction and/or major repairs, to extend the contract performance period in the cases under Article 95(1), points 8 and 9, of this Federal Law, as regards the contractual periods for those works. Such extension is subject to compliance with Article 95(1), points 8 and 9, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 62 Art. 112

units.text: 2) if during performance the contract price exceeds the estimated construction, reconstruction or major repair cost of the facility, determined following verification of its reliability during State expert examination of design documentation, the contract price shall be reduced taking account of that estimated cost.
units.label: Point 2 Part 62 Art. 112

units.text: 63. The result under a contract simultaneously covering design documentation and/or engineering surveys and construction or reconstruction of capital construction facilities shall be a building or structure for which a permit to put it into operation has been obtained under Russian Federation urban development legislation.
units.label: Part 63 Art. 112

units.text: 63.1. Until 1 January 2027, if design documentation provides for equipment necessary for operation of a capital construction facility, the contract may include its supply alongside construction, reconstruction and/or major repairs. The contract shall separately state:
units.label: Part 63.1 Art. 112

units.text: 1) the cost of construction, reconstruction and/or major repairs of the capital construction facility;
units.label: Point 1 Part 63.1 Art. 112

units.text: 2) the cost of supplying equipment specified in the design documentation and necessary for operation of the capital construction facility.
units.label: Point 2 Part 63.1 Art. 112

units.text: 64. Repealed. — Federal Law of 16.04.2022 No. 104-FZ.
units.label: Part 64 Art. 112

units.text: 64.1. Until 31 December 2024, a contracting authority may omit performance-security and warranty-security requirements from the procurement notice, invitation, procurement documentation where required by this Federal Law, and draft contract. This paragraph does not apply if the contract provides for an advance and the advance payments are not subject to treasury support.
units.label: Part 64.1 Art. 112

units.text: 65. Repealed. — Federal Law of 16.04.2022 No. 104-FZ.
units.label: Part 65 Art. 112

units.text: 65.1. By agreement of the parties, material terms of a contract concluded before 1 January 2027 may be amended if circumstances beyond their control arise during performance and make performance impossible. Such amendment shall comply with Article 95(1.3)–(1.6) of this Federal Law and be based on a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation, the constituent entity's highest executive authority or the local administration for federal, constituent-entity or municipal procurement respectively.
units.label: Part 65.1 Art. 112

units.text: 65.2. Until 31 December 2026, the parties may agree to amend material terms of a contract for medicinal products, medical devices or consumables if, at the contracting authority's proposal, their contractual quantity is increased or reduced by no more than thirty percent. Subject to Russian Federation budget legislation, the parties may change the contract price in proportion to the additional quantity, based on the contractual unit price, but by no more than thirty percent of the contract price. If quantities are reduced, the parties shall reduce the contract price based on the unit price. The unit price of additional supplies, or of the products, devices or consumables when quantities are reduced, shall be the original contract price divided by their contractual quantity.
units.label: Part 65.2 Art. 112

units.text: 65.3. Until 31 December 2024, the parties may agree to amend material terms of a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) concluded under Article 93(1), points 3, 40, 41, 46, 52, 56, 59 and 62, of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 65.3 Art. 112

units.text: 66. Until 31 December 2026, contracting authorities and authorised bodies and institutions may, for State needs of the Republic of Crimea and the federal city of Sevastopol, procure equipment and machinery; engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, construction, reconstruction, major and routine repairs and demolition of capital construction facilities, including roads; road and/or artificial road-structure maintenance performed by a company wholly owned by Crimea or Sevastopol, or by a State budget-funded or autonomous institution or State unitary enterprise subordinate respectively to the Crimean executive authority responsible for transport and roads or the Sevastopol executive authority responsible for public transport services and road and transport infrastructure development; construction supervision performed by the federal executive authority responsible for construction, architecture and urban planning policy and regulation or its subordinate State budget-funded or autonomous institution; preservation of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation; and site improvement, either under this Federal Law's procedure or by selecting a method under Article 24 of this Federal Law in the procedure agreed with the federal executive authority authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation and established by regulatory legal acts of Crimea or Sevastopol respectively. Advance payments received by legal entities under contracts resulting from selection under those regional procedures shall be subject to treasury support in the established procedure.
units.label: Part 66 Art. 112

units.text: 67. Until 31 December 2026, contracting authorities and authorised bodies and institutions may, for municipal needs of municipalities of the Republic of Crimea and the federal city of Sevastopol, procure equipment and machinery; engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, construction, reconstruction, major and routine repairs and demolition of capital construction facilities, including roads; road and/or artificial road-structure maintenance performed by a company wholly owned by Crimea or Sevastopol, or by a State budget-funded or autonomous institution or State unitary enterprise subordinate respectively to the Crimean executive authority responsible for transport and roads or the Sevastopol executive authority responsible for public transport services and road and transport infrastructure development; construction supervision performed by the federal executive authority responsible for construction, architecture and urban planning policy and regulation or its subordinate State budget-funded or autonomous institution; preservation of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation; and site improvement, either under this Federal Law's procedure or by selecting a method under Article 24 of this Federal Law in the procedure agreed with the federal executive authority authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation and established by regulatory legal acts of Crimea or Sevastopol respectively. Advance payments received by legal entities under contracts resulting from selection under those regional procedures shall be subject to treasury support in the established procedure.
units.label: Part 67 Art. 112

units.text: 68. Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ.
units.label: Part 68 Art. 112

units.text: 69. This Federal Law's provisions concerning cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation also apply to identified cultural heritage sites.
units.label: Part 69 Art. 112

units.text: 70. In the cases and procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, in 2021–2023 Article 95(1)(8) of this Federal Law also applies to contracts concluded for less than one year for construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of capital construction facilities or preservation of cultural heritage sites.
units.label: Part 70 Art. 112

units.text: 71. In 2022, 2023 and 2024, when contracting authorities that are federal or constituent-entity executive authorities, subordinate State institutions or State unitary enterprises, or municipal medical organisations determine the procurement volume under Article 30(1) of this Federal Law, procurement of medicinal products for human use and medical devices shall be excluded from total annual procurement volume.
units.label: Part 71 Art. 112

units.text: 72. Until 31 December 2026, the annual procurement ceiling of fifty million roubles shall not apply to procurement under Article 93(1)(4) of this Federal Law by the federal executive authorities and their subordinate State institutions and State unitary enterprises specified in Article 93(1)(56) of this Federal Law, or by the federal executive authority procuring for federal needs of State bodies established to support the President and Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 72 Art. 112

units.text: 73. The Government of the Russian Federation may establish special rules for planning and conducting procurement in 2023–2026 for State needs of the Donetsk People's Republic, Lugansk People's Republic, Zaporozhye Region and Kherson Region and municipal needs of municipalities within them.
units.label: Part 73 Art. 112

units.text: 74. Until 31 December 2024, this Federal Law shall not apply to procurement of goods, work or services by electoral commissions located in the Donetsk People's Republic, Lugansk People's Republic, Zaporozhye Region or Kherson Region.
units.label: Part 74 Art. 112

units.text: 75. Until 31 December 2025, the annual volume limits for electronic requests for quotations under Article 24(10)(1) of this Federal Law shall not apply.
units.label: Part 75 Art. 112

units.text: 76. Through 30 June 2024 inclusive, executive authorities and State institutions of a constituent entity, and municipal institutions within it, may procure medicines, specialised therapeutic foods, medical devices, consumables, disinfectants, related storage and delivery services, and repair and maintenance of medical devices from that constituent entity's State unitary enterprise if its legislative acts empower the enterprise to supply those goods or provide those services or works for these contracting authorities. The contracting authority shall notify the relevant procurement oversight body in the manner and within the period specified in Article 93(2) of this Federal Law. No procurement notice is required. The contracting authority shall determine and justify the contract price under this Federal Law and include that justification in the contract.
units.label: Part 76 Art. 112

units.text: 77. Until electronic signatures created under foreign law or international standards are recognised under Federal Law No. 63-FZ of 6 April 2011 On Electronic Signatures as meeting the attributes of enhanced electronic signatures, where a procurement participant is a foreign person registered in that State and lacks a qualified electronic signature verification-key certificate obtained from an accredited certification authority:
units.label: Part 77 Art. 112

units.text: 1) in performing a contract with that participant, the provisions of this Federal Law governing preparation, signing and sending, without enhanced electronic signatures or the unified information system, of acceptance documents, reasoned refusals to sign them, documents for liability measures or other actions concerning contractual breaches, amendment and termination agreements, unilateral refusal decisions and notices cancelling those decisions shall apply;
units.label: Point 1 Part 77 Art. 112

units.text: 2) filing, withdrawal and consideration of complaints shall be governed by Article 105(10), except point 2's requirement to attach the invitation, and Article 106(8)(2) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 77 Art. 112

units.text: 78. Through 30 September 2028 inclusive, contracting authorities may conduct procurement of goods under Article 93(12) of this Federal Law for State or municipal preschool, general education and vocational education organisations on electronic platforms operated by operators of intermediary digital platforms included in the register of intermediary digital platforms provided for by Federal Law No. 289-FZ of 31 July 2025 On Certain Issues of Regulating the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 78 Art. 112

units.text: 79. For paragraph 78 of this Article, an intermediary digital platform operator means a non-public commercial company satisfying Federal Law No. 289-FZ of 31 July 2025 On Certain Issues of Regulating the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 79 Art. 112

units.text: 80. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish special rules for applying the requirements in Article 24.1(2), points 1 and 2, of this Federal Law to operators of platforms conducting procurement under paragraph 78 of this Article and/or to operation of those platforms.
units.label: Part 80 Art. 112

units.text: 81. The Government of the Russian Federation shall approve the list of electronic platform operators on whose platforms procurement under paragraph 78 of this Article is conducted.
units.label: Part 81 Art. 112

units.text: 82. Platforms whose operators are included in the list under paragraph 81 of this Article shall conduct only procurement specified in paragraph 78 of this Article.
units.label: Part 82 Art. 112

units.text: 83. Contracts resulting from procurement under paragraph 78 of this Article shall require the supplier to deliver goods using the logistics infrastructure of an electronic platform operator included in the list under paragraph 81 of this Article.
units.label: Part 83 Art. 112

units.text: 84. Electronic platform operators included in the list under paragraph 81 of this Article are exempt from Article 44(7) of this Federal Law's requirement to conclude an interaction agreement with each bank included in the list under Article 44(5)(1)(а) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 84 Art. 112

units.text: 85. Banks included in the list under Article 44(5)(1)(а) of this Federal Law are exempt from the first sentence of Article 44(8) of this Federal Law's requirement to conclude an interaction agreement with each electronic platform operator if that operator is included in the list under paragraph 81 of this Article.
units.label: Part 85 Art. 112

units.text: 86. An interaction agreement between a platform operator included in the list under paragraph 81 of this Article and a bank included in the list under Article 44(5)(1)(а) of this Federal Law shall be concluded solely for procurement under paragraph 78 of this Article.
units.label: Part 86 Art. 112

units.text: 87. Until 31 December 2027, the contracting authority may conduct an electronic request for quotations under this Federal Law if the initial (maximum) contract price does not exceed twenty million roubles.
units.label: Part 87 Art. 112
